name: queens_n13__v1_h
prompt:
Place 13 queens on a 13×13 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 13 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 12) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.

Partial assignment (fixed values that must be respected):
- q[1]=12, q[11]=1
Return a complete solution consistent with these fixed assignments.
